usedFor: Wildapricot manages members and Microsoft Excel keeps the sheet, so “New Payment Arrives” can feed “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment Arrives” in Wildapricot, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each payment is logged as a row, giving you a running ledger.

watchOut: Refunds use a separate trigger, “New Refund Created”, so build one if you want them in the same sheet.
